blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos has signed into law a measure institutionalizing the Department of Education’s (DepEd) voucher system, letting eligible K-12 students transfer to private schools to help relieve public school overcrowding. Described as landmark legislation, Republic Act No. 12327, or the Basic Education Voucher Assistance Act, was signed by Marcos on Nov. 12 […]...
